Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: aiding-shifu
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle is a purely informational knowledge base for the 'Aiding Shifu' (艾登师傅) platform, providing product descriptions and service details for a home improvement service ecosystem. It contains no executable code, sensitive data access, or malicious instructions in SKILL.md or _meta.json.

llm.summary: This is an instruction-only knowledge-base skill that provides product/marketing information about the '艾登师傅' platform and its content, and its requested resources and instructions match that purpose.

dimensions.detail: The skill's name and description claim it is a product knowledge/marketing helper for the '艾登师傅' platform; the SKILL.md contains exactly that content (product overview, features, scenarios). It does not request unrelated credentials, binaries, or access.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md is a static knowledge document to be used when answering user questions. It does not instruct the agent to read system files, access hidden environment variables, execute commands, or transmit data to external endpoints beyond embedding a public product URL.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

llm.guidance: This skill is internally consistent: it only contains marketing/product documentation for the '艾登师傅' service and requests no credentials or installs. Before enabling, note that the source/homepage listed in the metadata is minimal (source unknown, no homepage field), so you may want to verify the content and the listed website (https://asf.dderp.cn) independently if provenance or up-to-dateness matters. Also be aware that, while the skill itself does not request secrets or perform external actions, any answers the agent generates using this content may include the documented URL or product claims—review outputs for accuracy before sharing with customers.
